# Pinned Etalon model codec backport

Origin: https://github.com/mediaprophet/etalon.git revision 6ace6cc6413a87ca10a1da58397ddc7c0b2fc41e, package crates/etalon-model (0.0.2).

This package preserves that revision's model/container APIs and architecture admission guards. The initial production source changes are restricted to src/ggml/blocks.rs, layout.rs and mod.rs: canonical supplier Q5_1 and MXFP4 decoding, layouts and dispatch. The Q5_0 high-bit expression is made explicit without changing the pinned decoder's result. The canonical working supplier's Q5_0/Q5_1 upper-bit defect was repaired before this backport; its three independent Q5 tests passed in the root-run supplier selector. Two independent MXFP4 edge-vector tests are included and passed in the isolated backport run.

The two new test children are routed from the otherwise preserved pinned tests.rs. No newer ModelHyperparams, LayerTensors, architecture guard, kquants or MoE router changes are imported. A subsequent narrow canonical repair also changes src/tensor_roles.rs and src/inference/mod.rs: role matching requires an exact dot component and .weight suffix, and fused QKV/expert aliases obey the same boundary. This prevents Q/K norms and scale/bias sidecars from becoming projection aliases. A new src/inference/tensor_alias_tests.rs exercises roles, alias normalization and the actual GGUF TensorIndex construction path. The current canonical supplier has further preexisting exclusions; those unrelated newer inference changes are not imported. All remaining original files are byte-identical to the pin; BACKPORT-SHA256.json records original and final SHA-256 hashes.

Cargo.toml materializes the pinned workspace package metadata, dependency versions/features and lint settings. The former sibling path dependency resolves to exactly the SAME pinned etalon-inference-kernel git URL/revision as Qualia's existing facade. A local workspace boundary prevents accidental inheritance from Qualia. No new numerical kernel implementation or second kernel revision is introduced. Root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock integration is separate and is not performed by this package preparation.

LICENSE, LICENSE-QUALIA and upstream-licenses are copied byte-for-byte from the pinned repository. Original attribution and license declarations are retained. This local backport does not alter those terms and is marked publish=false.

Validation: the isolated offline supplier build with inference-model passed 17 GGML unit tests (including three Q5 and two MXFP4 cases), then all six ggml_contract integration tests passed. Local Cargo.lock resolves exactly the pinned kernel git identity. Logs are stored in the QBDL evidence directory as etalon-vendor-ggml-tests.log and etalon-vendor-ggml-contract-tests.log. The isolated target is target-isolated; root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock were untouched. Gemma physical-model execution is still pending; the root coordinator owns monolithic core integration and execution. Independent fixture sources: GGML's public Q5 and MXFP4 layout/quantization definition, https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/blob/master/src/ggml-quants.c. Tests use single-bit Q5 cases and a natural E2M1/f64 power-of-two oracle rather than copying the production arithmetic.

Physical-model follow-up: root core selector passed 12 synthetic Gemma cases but all four Gemma/Qwen physical smoke tests stopped at duplicate Q projection aliases from the pinned supplier. The strict Qualia plans remain unchanged; this role repair addresses the source alias defect. Focused new supplier results and later physical reruns must be reported separately.

Final alias-repair validation: isolated vendor inference-model library tests passed 108/108 (including all three alias regressions and existing role/codec cases), exit0. The first final attempt hit Windows LNK1104 replacing its test executable; a retry with inherited host environment succeeded. Logs: etalon-vendor-alias-regression-tests.log (link failure), etalon-vendor-alias-regression-retry.log (108 pass). Canonical supplier source mirrors the role repair and tests, but was not separately compiled in this increment. Physical model reruns remain root-owned and pending.
